title: Arabidopsis Atlas: a FAIR, literature-grounded interactive structural, expression and metabolome atlas of Arabidopsis thaliana
description: An interactive, organ-selectable 3D atlas of Arabidopsis thaliana, built as a scientifically-grounded counterpart to the procedurally-generated rice-atlas viewer. Organ geometry cites peer-reviewed developmental-biology literature rather than being invented; a spaceflight-response layer, absent from the original, is computed directly from real NASA Open Science Data Repository (OSDR) count matrices for root (OSD-120) and whole-seedling (OSD-314) studies; developmental gene expression is linked to the real Klepikova/TraVA atlas rather than redistributed. Every number the viewer and accompanying manuscript display traces to a script-produced file in this repository, checked against this project's own pre-publication evidence gate before release. A metabolome layer combines three published natural-variation metabolome GWAS panels (Naake et al. 2024 seeds; Wu et al. 2018 leaves under control and stress; Zhu et al. 2024 leaves under extended darkness) and links them to the OSD-522 spaceflight transcriptome (PyDESeq2, permutation-tested pathway sets) and shoot proteome, shown per ecotype in the viewer and on a CoSE-themed showcase page.
